preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 5000, inclusive.
The length of the string s in each test case is between 1 and 5000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each character in s is a lowercase Latin letter.
preconditions.description: The string s consists of lowercase Latin letters only.

postconditions.expression: The output contains exactly t test cases.
postconditions.description: Each test case must produce an output string s' and an integer k.

postconditions.expression: The output string s' is lexicographically smallest among all possible strings obtained by reversing substrings of length k.
postconditions.description: The output string s' must be the lexicographically smallest possible string that can be achieved by reversing substrings of length k for some k.

postconditions.expression: The integer k is the smallest possible value that achieves the lexicographically smallest output string s'.
postconditions.description: The integer k must be the smallest possible value among all possible k that can achieve the lexicographically smallest output string s'.
